question: What was the profession of freedom fighter Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lawyer**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das was a prominent Indian freedom fighter and lawyer.
 
• He played a significant role in the Indian independence movement and was known for his legal acumen and dedication to the cause of freedom.
 
• Chittaranjan Das defended many political leaders and activists who were prosecuted by the British authorities.
 
• He is also known for his efforts in the Non-Cooperation Movement and his association with the Indian National Congress.
 
• Das was a mentor to several other prominent freedom fighters, including Subhas Chandra Bose.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Born on 5th November 1870, Chittaranjan Das hailed from a well-known family in Bengal.
 
• He completed his education in England and returned to India to practice law.
 
• Das was also a poet and a writer, contributing significantly to Bengali literature.
 
• He founded the Swaraj Party in 1923 to further the cause of self-governance in India.
 
• Chittaranjan Das passed away on 16th June 1925, but his legacy continues to inspire generations of Indians.
